goal: RC12: Per-cell noise architecture. Increase independent noise channels from 5→10→25. Fix median bias regression. Break through 5/9 ceiling to 6+/9.
scope: Level C — Full architecture: single_pass_ar.py, gru_encoder.py, train_afcrps.py, test scripts

constraints.must_generalize: Any conditional scenario generation (IV, rates, FX, credit)
constraints.investigation_blocking: 5-6 diagnostic scripts required per experiment. Understand WHY, not just what.

quantitative_gaps.suite_8: 1 cell away on frac_pass AND mag_pass. 146b regression from 144b. Window floor 5.31% vs 5.0%.
quantitative_gaps.suite_2: h=1 CI 59.8%→90% (+30.2pp). Hardest gap. Need 2× interval width.
quantitative_gaps.suite_7: Calm h=1 51.4%→90% (+38.6pp). Same root cause as Suite 2.

mechanistic_understanding.why_factor_noise_works: W(25×5) has eff_rank 4.74. 5 independent channels can't be aligned to rank-1 by CRPS. Structural inductive bias.
mechanistic_understanding.why_plain_skip_fails: Linear(32→25) has 800 free params. CRPS optimizes them to rank-1 (69% energy in PC1). No structural resistance.
mechanistic_understanding.skip_variance_fraction: 2.7% of total delta variance. But 100% of eff_rank improvement.
mechanistic_understanding.aifs_comparison: Same loss, per-location noise (35K dims), 180M params → no collapse. Architecture is the key.
mechanistic_understanding.suite_8_regression: Factor noise W has level-shift factor (cosine=-0.87 with level). Shifts median DOWN. All 25 cells negative bias.

dead_ends: noise amplitude scaling (H0: zero effect at 3×)
plain Linear skip (H1: CRPS collapses to norm=0.10)
cum_cal at any weight (breaks KS or cointegration)
spread weight tuning (doesn't resolve fundamental CRPS structure)
literature: AIFS-CRPS (2412.15832): per-location noise, same afCRPS → no collapse
CRPS-LAM (2510.09484): global noise → same collapse as us. Confirms architecture is key.
Repulsive ensembles (2106.11642): Jacobian repulsion for diversity
Neural SDE heteroscedastic output (Kidger et al. 2021)
directions: RC12: H1 (n_factors=10, 30min) → H2 (bias fix, 30min) → H3 (per-cell CLN, 2h)
